deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: model catalog -> model: redwood/llm-3-quantized-v2, variant: eu-quant-v2, change_window: 2026-03-20T23:00Z-2026-03-21T02:00Z, initial_traffic: 10% eu-west, rollout_strategy: gradual. Release notes link: https://docs.internal/release/2177778888

sara: Heads-up — I'm going to enable the EU variant at 10% for the start of the window. Will keep US full-swap paused until EU passes safety gates.

liam: ack. Can we pin fallback ordering so that if eu-quant-v2 misbehaves we go to eu-quant-v1 before global fallbacks? Want local failover first.

neha: +1. Set fallback ladder: 1) eu-quant-v1 (non-quant), 2) global-llm-3-small, 3) degrade-to-embeddings-route. Also set KV-cache warmup flag for eu-quant-v2.

olga: Ops request — please add an eviction grace of 30s to prevent thrash on transient OOMs. Also add p50/p95 latency budgets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 420ms for EU region during the window.

deploy-bot: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/model-rollout. Actions queued: 
- set traffic("eu-west", 10%, variant=eu-quant-v2)
- set fallback_priority(eu-west, [eu-quant-v1, global-llm-3-small])
- apply-eviction-grace(eu-west, 30s)
- enable-kv-warmup(eu-quant-v2)

liam: I'm posting a short smoke test set to prod-eu: `smoke_eu_basic.json` (50 prompts) — will watch quality/regression metrics for the next 20m after traffic shift.

neha: If regressions > 3% BLEU drop or > 5% QPS error increase, rollback condition triggered. Do we want automatic rollback or manual?

sara: Manual rollback opt-in. Ops will trigger auto-eviction for catastrophic resource errors (OOM spikes > 2x baseline). Otherwise manual to avoid flapping.

ops-oncall: I'll be watching infra metrics and can flip rollback if we cross the eviction threshold. Can we reduce autoscaler sensitivity during the window? It causes scale thrash.

olga: Yes — set autoscaler cooldown to 120s for eu-quant-v2 pools for the window. I'll patch the scaling policy now.

sara: Release notes short blurb for external customers: "Improved token efficiency and lower latency for chat workloads in EU by enabling quantized variant. Initial rollout limited to 10% with safety gates.
Note: If you hit degraded responses, please reach out to support or set region pinning in catalog." Feel free to edit.

liam: small ask: pin the old variant id `redwood/llm-3-quantized-v1@2025-11-04` as a fallback target in the catalog so rollbacks are deterministic.

deploy-bot: command executed: `set_catalog_pin redwood/llm-3-quantized-v1@2025-11-04 --scope=eu-west --reason="rollback target"` — success.

neha: I'll wire the canary dashboards: quality/regression/latency/error_budget. Notify #oncall-alerts if any gate trips.

sara: timeline: +00m start traffic shift 10% -> wait 20m smoke -> if green ramp to 40% over 1h -> hold -> final decision at +3h.

ops-oncall: noted. I will set an alert threshold: EU p95 latency > 500ms OR error rate increase > 7% -> pager to ops-oncall.

olga: Added autoscaler cooldown and eviction policy. Pushing policy commit to infra: `infra/policies/eu-quant-v2.json`

liam: quick check — are metrics for KV hit-rate exposed? We should expect warmup to show >65% hit-rate within 10m.

neha: yes, KV.hit_rate.euwest -> dashboard visible. I'll watch it.

sara: if after 3h we still see small perf regressions but error/latency OK, we keep rollout paused and extend window by 2h for further observation.

deploy-bot: rollout step complete: traffic set to 10% (eu-west). Event log id: evt-2177778888-01.

liam: smoke tests running now — posting sample failure snippet if we see one.

neha: gating note for posterity: gating criteria = [BLEU_drop<=3%, latency_p95<=420ms, kv_hit_rate>=65%, error_rate_delta<=5%].

ops-oncall: all hands on the alert channel if any gate trips. I'll standby.

sara: thanks team. I'll update release notes with the exact gating thresholds and the rollback procedure once smoke completes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: final: reminder to document any manual rollback steps in event log. If manual rollback occurs, run: `catalog.rollback model redwood/llm-3-quantized-v2 --target redwood/llm-3-quantized-v1@2025-11-04 --region=eu-west`

olga: I'll keep infra locks in place for 4h to avoid accidental full-swap.

sara: closing loop — will post a short postmortem if anything nontrivial happens. otherwise I'll drop a green-check in ~4h.
